title: A castle tower
done: You made a tower! It is as tall as two squares.

steps.say: Put a green square flat on the table.
Stand a blue square up on one side.
Stand a blue square up next to it.
Stand a blue square up on the back.
One more blue square. A box with no lid.
Put a purple square on top of a blue one.
Put a purple square on top, next to it.
The last purple square. The tower is tall.
